name: nimbus-fixed-rag-evaluation-v1
description: Twenty fixed questions. Relevant chunks are resolved by exact answer anchors after chunking, so qrels are chunk-level and reproducible.

questions.question: How long do Nimbus access tokens last?
questions.gold_answer: Nimbus access tokens expire after 15 minutes.

questions.question: How many active API keys may one service account have?
questions.gold_answer: Each service account can hold at most five active API keys.
relevant_anchors: service account can hold at most five active API keys

questions.question: How often does SCIM synchronize users and groups?
questions.gold_answer: SCIM provisioning synchronizes users and groups from the identity provider every 40 minutes.
relevant_anchors: synchronizes users and groups from the identity provider every 40 minutes

questions.question: When does a subscription upgrade take effect?
questions.gold_answer: Subscription upgrades take effect immediately and the remaining billing period is prorated.

questions.question: What is the storage overage price?
questions.gold_answer: Usage above the included storage allowance is billed at 12 cents per gigabyte-month.

questions.question: Within how many days must an invoice be disputed?
questions.gold_answer: Customers must contact support within 30 days to dispute an invoice.
relevant_anchors: contact support within 30 days to dispute an invoice

questions.question: What availability does Nimbus target for Enterprise?
questions.gold_answer: Nimbus targets 99.95 percent monthly availability for Enterprise organizations.

questions.question: How quickly is a Priority One incident acknowledged?
questions.gold_answer: The on-call engineer acknowledges Priority One incidents within 15 minutes.
relevant_anchors: acknowledges Priority One incidents within 15 minutes

questions.question: When is the written incident report delivered?
questions.gold_answer: A written incident report is delivered within five business days after resolution.
relevant_anchors: incident report is delivered within five business days

questions.question: What encryption protects stored customer data?
questions.gold_answer: Nimbus encrypts stored customer data with AES-256 and encrypts network traffic with TLS 1.3.
relevant_anchors: encrypts stored customer data with AES-256

questions.question: How long are Enterprise audit events retained?
questions.gold_answer: Audit log events are retained for 365 days on Enterprise and 90 days on Team.

questions.question: What happens immediately after a project is deleted?
questions.gold_answer: When a project is deleted, it enters a seven-day recoverable state.

questions.question: Which days are normal hosted service deployments?
questions.gold_answer: Nimbus deploys the hosted service on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
relevant_anchors: hosted service on Tuesdays and Thursdays

questions.question: How long does the initial five-percent canary run?
questions.gold_answer: Production rollout starts with a five-percent canary for 20 minutes.

questions.question: What error rate triggers automatic rollback?
questions.gold_answer: An automatic rollback begins if the five-minute error rate exceeds two percent or p95 latency rises by more than 40 percent from baseline.
relevant_anchors: five-minute error rate exceeds two percent

questions.question: Which webhook response status codes count as successful?
questions.gold_answer: A webhook delivery is considered successful for any response status from 200 through 299.

questions.question: Which algorithm signs webhook requests?
questions.gold_answer: Every webhook request includes an X-Nimbus-Signature header computed with HMAC-SHA256.

questions.question: What does the API return when a client is rate limited?
questions.gold_answer: A rate-limited request returns status 429 and a Retry-After header measured in seconds.
relevant_anchors: returns status 429 and a Retry-After header

questions.gold_answer: NO_RELEVANT_CONTEXT
